## Who this site is for

1. **Recruiters & hiring managers** — senior/mid+ front-end roles, product teams, React / Next.js / TypeScript, e-commerce background.
2. **Store owners & e-commerce managers** — direct Magento 2 / Hyvä frontend help without agency layers: migrations, Hyvä rebuilds, performance, checkout/CMS, ongoing support.
3. **Anyone comparing both** — the homepage routes visitors to the right path in a few seconds.

## About Mykola Rudnev

- **Role:** Lead Front-End Developer (freelance) — Senior Front-End Developer
- **Experience:** 6+ years front-end; Magento 2 / Hyvä e-commerce, React / Next.js product work, Shopify Liquid themes
- **Current focus:** HUBER SE (direct freelance) — Magento Open Source + Hyvä Theme / Checkout / CMS storefront; Core Web Vitals and technical SEO
- **Own product:** [Claspwell](https://www.claspwell.com/) — catalog-aware Magento 2 / Hyvä AI sales assistant (Next.js + Payload CMS, Fastify API, Alpine widget, Magento module)
- **Work style:** Direct communication, B2B-friendly, remote across EU; async-friendly; clear scope before delivery
- **Languages:** English (fluent), Polish (fluent), Ukrainian & Russian (native)

## Case studies (in-depth)

- https://www.mrudnev.com/case-studies/huber-se-hyva-migration — HUBER SE: Adobe Commerce headless → Magento Open Source + Hyvä Theme / Checkout / CMS; sole frontend; Lighthouse 99 category / 100 product (Aug 2026).
- https://www.mrudnev.com/case-studies/claspwell-magento-ai — Claspwell: founder-built Magento AI sales assistant; Next.js + Payload CMS production site, Fastify API, Alpine/Hyvä widget, Magento module.
- https://www.mrudnev.com/case-studies/pixel25-shopify-garage — Pixel25: custom Shopify theme for an automotive garage SaaS (in development).
- https://www.mrudnev.com/case-studies/glasy-shopify-storefront — Glasy: custom Shopify eyewear theme from scratch; live at glasy.pl.
- https://www.mrudnev.com/case-studies/hrk-seo-growth — HRK recruitment platform (Gatsby, TypeScript); technical SEO and performance; ~+50% organic traffic in 3 months (executive metric).
- https://www.mrudnev.com/case-studies/ponadczasowi-nextjs-ecommerce — Ponadczasowi watch e-commerce (Next.js); checkout, payments, shipping, mobile performance.

## Services (Magento 2 / Hyvä)

- Frontend bug fixing and stabilization after quick fixes
- New sections, components, CMS-driven pages (Hyvä CMS)
- PLP, PDP, cart, checkout, account improvements
- Core Web Vitals and Lighthouse-oriented performance work
- Post-launch support, maintenance, short sprints
- Hyvä migration and legacy / headless theme replacement

## Engagement models

- **Audit + action plan** — when priorities are unclear after launch or backlog chaos
- **Implementation sprint** — fixed scope over 1–4 weeks with a concrete task list
- **Ongoing support** — monthly capacity for stores without a dedicated front-end owner

Details: https://www.mrudnev.com/pricing

## Technical stack

- **Front-end:** JavaScript (ES6+), TypeScript, React, Next.js, Gatsby.js, Alpine.js
- **E-commerce:** Magento 2, Hyvä Theme, Hyvä CMS, Hyvä Checkout, Shopify (Liquid, custom sections & blocks)
- **Styling:** Tailwind CSS, Styled Components, SCSS / LESS
- **APIs & data:** REST, GraphQL, Payload CMS, PostgreSQL
- **Quality:** Core Web Vitals, technical SEO, accessibility (WCAG), component architecture, Storybook
- **Tooling:** Git, GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Docker, CI/CD, ESLint, Prettier, Figma, Azure DevOps, JIRA, Cursor / Claude

**Shopify (custom Liquid themes):** Glasy, Pixel25, Warmsome, Ascent, Berg's, Diamandia.
